subject: Hosted API pilot: quick sync to validate sandbox access
messages:
From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@shopgrid.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick sync to enable Hosted API sandbox (ShopGrid)

Hi Naomi —

I signed up for the Hosted API sandbox earlier this morning (self-serve) and wanted to request a short 30–40 minute sync to validate API keys, rate limits, and the typical inference cost profile for our use case. We're trying to get a pilot running next week.

A few quick items we'd like to cover if possible:
- Confirm sandbox access & API key provisioning
- Default token limits / concurrency recommendations for small pilot
- Any known model presets for short-generation search re-ranker workload

I'm in PST (San Francisco) and am available
- Mon 12/13 between 9–11am
- Tue 12/14 between 1–4pm

I've attached a short outline of our pilot goals. Can you or someone on your team propose a time?

Thanks,
Ethan Liu
Senior PM, ShopGrid
ethan.liu@shopgrid.com

Attachment: shopgrid-pilot-outline.pdf (pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@shopgrid.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick sync to enable Hosted API sandbox (ShopGrid)

Hi Ethan —

Thanks for the signup and the clear outline. Happy to run a short session to walk through keys, quotas, and expected cost patterns. I CC'd Diego on this thread — he handles calendar ops and will send a confirmed invite.

Two quick clarifying questions so we can tailor the session:
1) Which model family are you planning to try? (we can prepare recommended quantization / batch settings)
2) Will you have a technical attendee (engineer) on the call who will test requests live?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon 12/13 9:30–10:00am (30m)
- Mon 12/13 10:30–11:10am (40m)
- Tue 12/14 1:30–2:00pm (30m)

If none of those work, reply with a couple options and Diego will match calendar availability.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
